title: Investigate a failed delivery
text: Integration Lab is a working demonstration of webhook failure and recovery. Its orders are synthetic, while signatures, HTTP requests and database writes are real.

title: Inspect the failure history
text: Run outage scenario sends four requests to an unavailable receiver. The virtual retry clock advances explicitly. The delivery becomes a dead letter, with every failed attempt still visible.

title: Restore service and replay
text: Set the receiver to Healthy, choose Replay and repair sender, then send the next attempt. The receiver records one order effect. The earlier failure history remains available.

title: Check duplicate safety
text: Queue a duplicate and send it. The receiver returns its stored response without applying the order again. Compare the delivery history with the order ledger.

title: Recover an ambiguous outcome
text: A harder case loses the response after committing. The receipt and order update are real; the failure response is injected. Retrying still leaves one order effect.

title: Inspect the design
text: The public service uses a Worker and D1. A local ASP.NET Core implementation shares its HTTP contract. The architecture board explains the receipt, retry and audit boundaries.

title: Understand the demonstration's limits
text: This is a bounded synthetic demonstration. The browser sends deliveries and controls virtual retry time. Recorded validation and source code let you inspect the behaviour and its limits.
